title: Projects Module Schema
description: Structure to be produced by a Projects Extractor (designed in Milestone T3/Phase 1 -- the extractor exists as scaffolding, has NOT been wired into pipeline/parser_pipeline.py, and has NOT been validated against any real Ollama call in this milestone) -- a single resume-section module, not the full resume schema. Field set is evidence-derived from direct inspection of all 7/22 corpus resumes containing a dedicated Projects section, including the resume-001 case Milestone T2/Phase 0 traced as a real Work-Experience misrouting failure (docs/MILESTONE_T3_PHASE1_SCHEMA_FOUNDATION.md Part B), not assumed from a generic resume-schema template.

name.description: REQUIRED-shape field. Real evidence: 100% of examined project-bearing resumes (7/7) have a clear project title/heading.

description.description: REQUIRED-shape field. Real evidence: a short tagline/summary line is present in most examples (e.g. 'Sustainable Women's Activewear Brand - Headless Shopify Solution'); where absent, the first highlight bullet effectively serves this role.

role.description: OPTIONAL. Real evidence: present in ~50% of examined resumes as a preceding tag/heading (e.g. 'Full-Stack', 'Frontend Developer (Freelance)'); entirely absent for others (e.g. resume 016's two projects have no role label at all).

start_date.description: OPTIONAL. Real evidence: present in ~50% of examined resumes (e.g. resume 001's 'Aug 2023 - Oct 2025'); absent for others (e.g. resume 016, Ankush Mehta).

end_date.description: OPTIONAL. Same evidence basis as start_date.

highlights.description: REQUIRED-shape (array, may be empty). Real evidence: bullet-point detail lines are present for effectively every examined project, mirroring work_experience's own established `responsibilities` field exactly, for representational consistency.

technologies.description: REQUIRED-shape (array, may be empty). Real evidence: technology names appear in prose across all examined project entries (e.g. 'Next.js 15 & React 19', 'React.js and Tailwind CSS'), mirroring work_experience's own established `technologies` field. Per this milestone's Part C relationship design, these values MUST NOT be automatically copied into the canonical `skills` array by any assembler/merger logic -- see validators/misrouting_detector.py and the milestone report's explicit prohibition.

url.description: OPTIONAL, inconsistent evidence. Real evidence: recoverable in 1/7 examined resumes (embedded directly in a project heading, e.g. '(https://senraa.com/)'); a bare 'Project Link' label with no recoverable value was found in another (consistent with this project's own already-documented PDF-hyperlink-annotation loss, V3.7) -- absent for the remainder.
